transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... I'm just having some trouble explaining things lately. At work. I work with jewelry. 

Someone will ask me a really simple question, like when a ring repair is going to be ready, and... I don't know, my answer just sort of goes everywhere. I'll start talking about invoices, and then somehow I'm on about garden soil... or mortgage papers. I can just see them losing me. So... that's why I came in.
Are you experiencing these difficulties with your thoughts and explanations at home or in social situations as well, or is it mainly at work?
I'm not really sure... I guess I mostly just notice it at the shop. I don't really go out to social things much, so... yeah. Just at work, I suppose.
Do you use any alcohol or drugs?
No. I don't use anything like that. Just... coffee, I guess. That's it.
Are you feeling anxious or upset when this happens and you can't explain things clearly at work?
I don't know. I guess... maybe a little frustrated. But not really anxious or upset, I don't think. Just... it just happens.
Do you feel like your thoughts are jumbled or hard to follow when this happens at work?

I suppose so. It's... well, it's why I came in, really. Someone will ask me something simple at the shop, like... when a ring repair will be ready. And I try to answer, but... it's like my words just drift. I start talking about the invoices, and then... somehow I'm talking about garden soil, or mortgage papers. I don't know how I get there. I can just... see them losing me. It's hard to explain.
Have you ever had a time when you heard or saw things that others couldn't?

I... well, sometimes. When the shop is really quiet. I'll hear... it sounds like a woman muttering my name, coming from back in the polishing room. Or I'll smell burning metal, even when I know the torches are off. It's... it feels real enough that I'll go back there to check. But... there's no one there.
Do you have times when your thoughts are clear and you can explain things easily at work?
I don't really know. I guess... sometimes it's okay. But I haven't really thought about it.
Do you have days where your thoughts are clear and organized all day at work?
I... I don't really know. Maybe. I just... I don't keep track of it like that.
Do you have times when your thoughts are completely clear and organized, without any trouble explaining things, for an entire day?
I... I'm not really sure. I don't think I can give you a straight answer on that. I just do my work and go home.
Do you have any days where you don't experience any trouble with your thoughts or explanations at all?
I really couldn't tell you. I just... I sit at my bench and do my work. I don't pay attention to whether my thoughts are perfect or not.
Do you have any periods of time where your thoughts are completely normal and you have no trouble explaining things?

Well... no. Not really. That's actually why I'm here. It's just... someone will ask me a simple question at the shop, you know, like when a ring repair will be ready. And I try to answer, but... it just goes off track. I start talking about the invoices, and then somehow it's about garden soil, and then mortgage papers... and I can just see them looking at me, completely lost. It's... it's not normal.
Do you ever have trouble explaining things or making sense when talking to family or friends at home?
I don't know... I guess I don't really talk much when I get home. I just kind of keep to myself.
Do you have any times when your thoughts are completely clear and organized for a whole week or longer?
I... I'm not really sure. I don't really keep track of things like that. I just try to get through the days.
Has your difficulty with explaining things and keeping your thoughts on track at work caused you any significant problems or stress in your daily life?

Well... yes. It's... it's been hard. I've actually had to... cut back on doing custom pieces. I just... I miss the deadlines for repairs now. And when I try to talk to clients about what they want, I just lose track of everything. I even have to get my husband to look over the invoices for me now... I used to do all of that myself. It's just... too much right now.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are not your own or are being controlled by something outside of yourself?
No... I don't think so. I don't really know what you mean by that. They're just... my own thoughts.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your mood or emotional state over the past few months?

I suppose so... yes. It's just... most mornings, I wake up and there's this... this flat, heavy sadness. It's like... like all the color has drained out of the house before I even make it down to the shop. It's just always there.
Do you still hear the woman muttering your name when you're alone in the shop?

Yes... sometimes. If the shop is quiet. I'll be sitting there and... I hear her muttering my name. It sounds like it's coming from the polishing room. Or... sometimes I'll smell burning metal, even when all the torches are completely off. It... it feels real enough that I usually go back there to check. But there's never anyone there.
Is your thinking usually disorganized like this, or are there times when it's more organized and focused?

I... I don't know. It's just... lately, it's been harder to keep things straight. That's actually why I came in. Someone will come into the shop and ask a simple question, like... when a ring repair will be ready. And I try to answer, but... my mind just sort of drifts. I'll start talking about the repair invoices, and then somehow I'm talking about the soil in my garden, and then the mortgage papers... and I can just see them looking at me, completely lost. I just... I can't seem to hold onto the thread of what I'm supposed to be saying.
Have you experienced these difficulties with your thoughts and explanations when you've had coffee?
I don't... I don't really drink coffee. So, no.
Do you have any times when your thinking is completely clear and organized for several days in a row?

Not really. ...Like I just told you, about the customers. When they ask about a ring, and I end up rambling about the garden and the mortgage. It's... it's just been like that most days. I don't really get long stretches where it's completely clear right now.
